sourceRefs.locator: V.1, opening and notes: Brunhild and her children in Paris, Childebert’s removal and Christmas accession in 575, subsequent separation of the family.
A Note on Genealogy and IV.27–28, 51: Chlothar’s sons, the marriages of Sigibert and Chilperic, and the death of Sigibert.
IX.20, Copy of the Agreement, preamble and clauses on Paris, Clodechild, Childebert’s children, Faileuba, Chlodosind, Galswinth’s cities, the leudes, travel and oaths.
pp. 103–104: Galswinth, marriage property, the immediate grant of Cahors to Brunhild and the four other cities retained by Guntram for his lifetime.

summary.de: Tochter des westgotischen Königs Athanagild und Mutter Childeberts II. Der Vertrag von Andelot nennt sie in seiner Einleitung und regelt ihren Anspruch auf Cahors.
summary.en: Daughter of the Visigothic king Athanagild and mother of Childebert II. The Andelot treaty names her in its preamble and settles her claim to Cahors.
